capabilities: Toggle heading shortcuts from heading 1-6 back to paragraph
Increase or decrease heading level with Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-
Insert underline, inline code, comments, images, math blocks and task lists
Apply Typora's keymap to Obsidian core commands in one click
List Typora actions with no Obsidian equivalent in settings
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin store; install via BRAT or manually. Hotkeys apply per vault, so other vaults need the same setup. Tested on Obsidian 1.14.x, Windows only.
intentEvidence: Bring Typora's editing shortcuts to Obsidian — including the ones Obsidian can't do on its own.
problem: Obsidian's built-in heading shortcuts don't toggle back to paragraph when pressed again, and Typora users lose their familiar editing keymap when switching.

relations.evidence: Bring Typora's editing shortcuts to Obsidian

summary: Keymap plugin that brings Typora's editing shortcuts to Obsidian, including toggleable heading shortcuts and one-click binding of Typora's core shortcuts.
